purpose: Reconcile per-agent real-v2 reward aggregates with the pinned published Groundtruth under registered cohort and reward variants; aggregate check only, no ranking

published_groundtruth.generating_path_as_inspected: experiments/compute_reward_from_ds.py in the pinned benchmark: loader get_dataset with use_compute_termination, remove_cons_terminals, registered bad_trajectories, eval_only, timesteps_to_include (0, 250) and set_terminals; progress recomputed from poses with the loader Progress tracker; pinned reward classes; rewards at and after the termination index set to the zero collision penalty; discount 0.99; numpy mean and population std per agent
published_groundtruth.membership_and_revision: unknown; the files carry no per-record membership or generating revision

selection.recording_start: timestep resets to zero; prior row done or truncated
selection.aggregation: discounted sum per whole retained recording; unweighted mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) across recordings per agent

loader.corrected: first compute_termination row of a recording retained; later rows of that recording excluded
loader.original: pinned helper scans consecutive compute_termination rows across the whole array; a reset row that continues a run from the previous recording is excluded

final_row.zero: reward of the final retained row set to zero, as the frozen rule and the inspected published path do
final_row.keep: final retained row keeps its reward; progress and checkpoint use the next archive row of the same recording when one exists, otherwise zero; lifetime and minimum action keep their formula values

reward_source.frozen_v2: experiments/common_reward_v2.reward_vectors on progress decoded from progress_sin and progress_cos; checkpoint credited on the arrival row
reward_source.departure_aligned: experiments/simulator_reward_adapter_v2.TransitionRewards on decoded progress; progress and checkpoint credited on the departure row
reward_source.pinned_source_class: pinned ProgressReward, LifetimeReward, MinActReward(-0.4189, 0.4189) and 10 x CheckpointReward on progress recomputed from poses_x and poses_y with the pinned Progress tracker (lookahead 200) and the pinned Infsaal3 centerline, tracker reset at each recording start, float64 arithmetic
reward_source.stored_new_rewards: archive new_rewards rows with their stored alignment and cutoff values
reward_source.pinned_source_class_gym_track: same pinned classes and tracker as pinned_source_class, but the tracker is built from the pinned gym Track.from_track_name('Infsaal3').centerline, whose Raceline.from_centerline_file closes the loop and resamples the CSV with a cubic spline at 0.1 m into float32 points; this is the track object the inspected published path hands to F110Env.compute_progress

enumeration: all 2 x 2 x 5 = 20 combinations on the same eligible recordings; the loader axis is expected to be inert for the 15 evaluation agents on real-v2 because runs/ope_corrected_v2/loader_sensitivity.json records zero changed evaluation reset rows

comparison.rule: an agent and reward match under a variant when both the mean and the population standard deviation are within tolerance of the published values; absolute differences only; no post hoc tolerance change; exact maximum differences and failing agents are reported even when no variant matches
comparison.tolerance_basis: runs/ope_corrected_v2/reference_comparison.json registers no tolerance; 1e-4 is about 30 times the largest minimum-action residual recorded there and about 85 times smaller than the largest progress residual, so it separates numerical residue from unexplained differences

self_check: the corrected/zero/frozen_v2 combination must reproduce the real-v2 means and standard deviations in runs/ope_corrected_v2/reward_aggregates.json within 1e-9 before any comparison is read
prospective_expectations: lifetime matches only with a zero final row; keep moves every horizon recording by about 0.99 to the power 249
checkpoint can match only under pinned_source_class because the published files carry the duplicated full-lap threshold that the frozen rule and the bridge both count once

no registered CSV-centerline axis is expected to remove the progress mean residual of up to 0.0085 recorded in reference_comparison.json; if none does, that residual stays attributed to cohort membership or generating revision, which these files cannot identify
the minimum-action residual of about 3e-6 is not explained by any registered axis and is expected to persist under every variant

output.public: runs/ope_groundtruth_reconciliation/result.json with per-variant per-agent means, standard deviations, differences and match flags
output.private: per-recording returns under every variant, outside git, with SHA-256 recorded in the public result

no_ranking: nothing from this run enters any controller ranking

amendment_before_execution.when: after the first sixteen variants were executed and before any gym-track outcome was computed
amendment_before_execution.reason: the sixteen registered variants left identical progress residuals (maximum mean difference 0.008537) under every progress source, so the remaining inspected difference between the reconstruction and the published path, the resampled gym centerline, is registered as a further variant rather than tuned in
amendment_before_execution.expectation: if the resampled centerline generated the published files, progress and checkpoint residuals fall to numerical levels under this variant; otherwise they persist and stay attributed to cohort or revision differences
